capture_contract.sequence: DRIVING/current-save proof; one natural baseline; 16 isolated P/N/captured-restore triplets; terminal restore; post-restore readback

capture_contract.restore: same-run captured typed baseline; source-default f32 baseline only after full-log Debug.ini absence and display proof
capture_contract.effect_credit: zero until independent review accepts attributed scene pixels/logs and original consumer witness
capture_contract.absent_scene: record missing scene/producer condition; never infer original no-op

probe_contract.jump_dump: BRN_JUMP_DUMP=1 logs first24 E_TYPE_JUMP generic-region indices/positions/dimensions plus total; no ID and no guaranteed target row

probe_contract.survey: 48-seat reverse-grid run covered lower surfaces only and earned zero camera credit
probe_contract.review_rule: Static asset/field changes, jump-dump rows, absent pixels, no camera hit, unchanged view or missing context are insufficient; never infer original no-op.
probe_contract.candidate_test_seat: Optional attempt at -301.309601,20.007740,1156.719654,247.004511 from prior pinned jump scenario; not validated camera coverage or current scene consumer
probe_contract.phase_producer: BRN_JUMP_DUMP is emitted once when TriggerData loads, lists only first24 E_TYPE_JUMP indices/positions/dimensions with no CgsID. No existing per-phase trigger draw/receiver producer is assumed.
